items.title: M&T Bank (MTB) Names Brian Green Chief Investment Officer
items.summary: M&T Bank (NYSE:MTB) appointed Brian Green as Chief Investment Officer for M&T Bank and Wilmington Trust. Green will oversee investment management activities tied to the wealth and institutional businesses across both platforms. The new CIO role places Green at the center of asset allocation, manager selection, and portfolio construction decisions for clients. items.title: M&T Bank Stock and Its Richer Credit Card Rewards Program What It Means For Shareholders
